title: Riya's readings at a beach
body: Riya lives in a small town on the coast of Kerala. On a sunny day she measured the temperature of the beach sand and of the sea water near the shore at two times. At 2 pm the sand was at 38 °C and the sea water at 29 °C. At 10 pm the sand was at 24 °C and the sea water at 27 °C. She also tied a light ribbon to a pole on the beach and noted which way it fluttered at each of the two times. Her grandmother told her that the windows of the old houses in their lane were built facing the sea for a reason.
